sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks for
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, mParticle, CleverTap, NPAW, Bugsnag, Firebase Analytics and Facebook from collecting usage data.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes video ads, pause ads and sponsored cards on the home, show and Shorts pages.
Opens the app and plays videos on rooted devices.
Unlocks Full HD playback. VIP titles require a subscription.
